text: Given ticket 456 has at least one action, When halopsa_tickets_list_actions(ticket_id=456) is called with no filters, Then the response's items contains only actions for ticket 456, each with id, who, who_type, who_agentid, note, outcome, datetime, new_status, old_status, hiddenfromuser, timetaken, time_taken_minutes, attachment_count, replied_to_action_id present when HaloPSA sent them.
evidence: uv run pytest -q @ c94ca03: 137 passed, 0 failed. Mocked GET /Tickets/456 (exists) and GET /Actions (one action for ticket 456 with every listed field set, plus replied_to_action_id: null). Asserts out["items"] == [one dict with id, ticket_id, who, who_type, who_agentid, note, outcome, datetime, new_status, old_status, hiddenfromuser, timetaken, time_taken_minutes (derived: 0.5h -> 30.0), attachment_count present; replied_to_action_id absent because it was null and pick() drops non-present/None fields] (tests/test_handlers.py).

text: Given ticket 789 exists and has zero actions, When the tool is called for ticket 789, Then items is an empty list and no error is returned.
evidence: uv run pytest -q @ c94ca03: 137 passed. Mocked GET /Tickets/789 (exists) and GET /Actions -> {"record_count": 0, "actions": []}. Asserts out["items"] == [] and "error" not in out (tests/test_handlers.py).

text: Given ticket_id=99999999 does not exist in HaloPSA, When the tool is called with that id, Then the tool returns a not_found error naming ticket 99999999, and no call to /Actions is made.
evidence: uv run pytest -q @ c94ca03: 137 passed. Mocked GET /Tickets/99999999 -> 404. Asserts out["error"]["code"] == "not_found", "99999999" in message, and the /Actions route was never called (route.called is False) -- the _require() existence check short-circuits before _fetch_actions runs (tests/test_handlers.py).

text: Given exclude_system=true and important_only=true are both passed, When the tool is called, Then the outgoing GET /Actions request includes both excludesys=true and importantonly=true, and no other filter query parameter is present.
evidence: uv run pytest -q @ c94ca03: 137 passed. Calls the tool with exclude_system=True, important_only=True; asserts the outgoing request has excludesys="true" and importantonly="true", and none of the other 9 filter query-param names are present (tests/test_handlers.py).

text: Given no optional filters are passed, When the tool is called, Then the outgoing GET /Actions request has none of the 11 filter query parameters set (only ticket_id and count).
evidence: uv run pytest -q @ c94ca03: 137 passed. Calls the tool with no optional arguments; asserts set(request.url.params.keys()) == {"ticket_id", "count"} -- all 11 filters are None-dropped by HaloClient.request's own params cleaning (api.py:188), nothing new needed in the tool itself (tests/test_handlers.py).

text: Given a ticket with an HTML-formatted note, When the tool is called with include_html_note=true against a live HaloPSA tenant, Then the matching action's note_html is present and non-empty in the response.
steps: With a real HaloPSA sandbox/test tenant (needs a real vendor account -- not available in this environment, per mcp-track.md 2.5 this does not block design or dev), find or create a ticket with an action that has an HTML-formatted note
Call halopsa_tickets_list_actions with that ticket_id and include_html_note=true
Inspect the matching action in the response
expect: The action's note_html field is present and non-empty, and reflects the HTML content of the note.
evidence: needs a real vendor account; not executed in this environment, per mcp-track.md 2.5/'completion standard' item 3 this does not block dev or INT publish. Unit coverage (test_list_actions_full_response_is_unslimmed) proves include_html_note is passed through and that an arbitrary field such as note_html is not dropped when present in HaloPSA's reply, but cannot confirm what a live tenant actually sends for that flag.

text: Given a ticket with 25 actions and limit=20, When the tool is called with no offset, Then items has 20 entries, has_more is true, and next_offset is 20; calling again with offset=20 returns the remaining 5 entries with has_more false.
evidence: uv run pytest -q @ c94ca03: 137 passed. Fake /Actions endpoint returns record_count=25 and the first `count` rows of a 25-row fixture (mirroring HaloPSA's own count-only semantics). First call (limit=20): items ids 0..19, has_more True, next_offset 20. Second call (offset=20, limit=20): items ids 20..24 (5 entries), has_more False, no next_offset key (tests/test_handlers.py).

text: Given no HaloPSA credential headers are sent, When the tool is called, Then it returns the not_configured error envelope, matching every other tool's behavior for the same condition.
evidence: uv run pytest -q @ c94ca03: 137 passed. Clears the credentials ContextVar (same pattern as test_missing_credentials_envelope for other tools) and asserts out["error"]["code"] == "not_configured" (tests/test_handlers.py). No special-casing was added for this tool -- it relies on run()'s existing not_configured path.

text: Given ticket_id is passed as a non-numeric value (e.g. "abc"), When the tool is called, Then it returns the invalid_argument error envelope (via seg()'s existing numeric-id check) rather than forwarding a malformed request to HaloPSA.
evidence: uv run pytest -q @ c94ca03: 137 passed. Calls the tool with ticket_id="abc"; asserts out["error"]["code"] == "invalid_argument". Rejected by FastMCP/pydantic's own int-coercion validation before the handler runs (same generic path test_argument_errors.py::test_wrong_type_is_invalid_argument_without_echoing_the_value already covers for any tool's first required scalar argument); seg()'s own numeric check inside the handler is the second line of defense for a value that does coerce (e.g. a negative or non-integer float) but is not a valid HaloPSA id segment.

text: Given the live tools/list output after this change, When compared against tests/fixtures/tools_baseline.json by the existing contract-test suite, Then every existing tool still has all of its baseline parameters with none newly required, no tool is renamed, and halopsa_tickets_list_actions appears with ticket_id as its only required parameter.
evidence: uv run pytest -q @ c94ca03: 137 passed. Added a baseline entry for halopsa_tickets_list_actions (required: ["ticket_id"]) to tests/fixtures/tools_baseline.json; every pre-existing tool's baseline entry is unchanged.
